basis: The dashboard shows a continuous downward trend in coastal water temperature from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015. The full-period change is a decrease of 14.0°C. This represents a 58.3% reduction from the baseline value. While no explicit numerical threshold is provided in the chart, a change of this magnitude (nearly 60% decrease) is not consistent with 'ordinary variation' and meets the ordinary meaning of a substantial change. Therefore, the record requires substantial-change follow-up.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 coastal water temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
